name: refund-payment
description: Refunds a Stripe payment in full or in part, moving money back to the customer; a refund cannot be undone. Takes a charge id, or a payment_intent id, from stripe__list-payments.

charge.description: A charge id from stripe__list-payments. Give exactly one of charge or paymentIntent.

paymentIntent.description: A payment_intent id from stripe__list-payments. Give exactly one of charge or paymentIntent.

amount.description: Optional amount to refund in the currency's smallest unit. Omit to refund the full remaining amount.

reason.description: Optional reason: duplicate, fraudulent or requested_by_customer.

metadata.description: Optional string metadata to attach to the refund.
